div.head: Abt 73
div.ab: Gif friwif locbore leswæs hwæt gedeþ, XXX scll' gebete.
Gif friwif locbore leswæs hwæt gedeþ, XXX scƚƚ gebete.
If a free woman in charge of the locks does anything seriously dishonest, let her pay 30 shillings.
If a freeborn woman, with long hair, misconducts herself, she shall pay 30 shillings as compensation.
If a freewoman, with long hair, commits any misconduct, she is to pay 30 shillings compensation.
Wenn eine Freie, eine Lockenträgerin, etwas Unzüchtiges thut, büsse [ihr Schänder ihrem Vormunde] 30 Schll.
If a free woman, one who wears locks, does something unchaste, let [the one who violated her] pay [her guardian] 30 shillings.
div.note: This is generally taken to be a distinguishing feature of a free, as opposed to a bond, woman.
